selection_rule: Keep the existing valid-domain prefilter, all six locations and all eight mutation values. Compute used_bits by the attached symbolic read/control proof. Keep case iff (mask & ~used_bits) == 0. Every removed case maps to (mask & used_bits, same location, same mutation), which remains in the unchanged valid domain and has exactly the same reached control/read sites. This is NOT deduplication by observed candidate or expected return.

mask_bits.512: map destination inventory is inventories[1], else NULL

read_proof.reason: target guard and final fixture state/menu/map-presence observation; no pruning of initial null character or map-entry alternatives
destination consumed by mapped path or retained in final map when target NULL

read_proof.condition: target present AND initial character present
read_proof.reason: preserve even the initial inventory load that a mapped entry later overwrites

read_proof.condition: initial character absent AND target present AND map entry present
read_proof.reason: retain validity-prefilter dependency even when successful equip makes pickup response unread

read_proof.condition: target present AND map entry present AND destination non-NULL AND 0 <= location <= 18
post-map fallthrough reaches non-NULL player and inventory; successful equip reloads player from menu after mutation 1/2
mapped equipment fallback OR has callback says absent
drop path reached (mapped NULL destination OR failed pickup)
read_proof.reason: position callback can replace menu character; subsequent resource manager/level is reloaded from that current character

mutation_proof.keep: all 0..7 for every selected mask/location, including unreachable points as negative sentinels
mutation_proof.effect: Matching point changes menu character to actor[1] and actor[0].inventory to inventories[1]. Inventory local must stay cached. Successful equip must reload current player; drop must load current player before position and again after its callback for getLevel. Keep callback order, receiver ids, arguments, full position bits, map contents, menu character and clicked-slot capture.

mode1_extra_proof: 0xad4b90 checks tracking global, calls return function when false, then unconditionally tail-calls vtable +0x48 updateLayout. Mode 1 must retain exactly one update on all 1364 cases, correct receiver, map state at update and clicked slot mutation 91.
risks_and_limits: This is a symbolic proposal; no fresh original/replacement run or wall timing has been performed. Do not change frozen inputs of running full acceptance.

Canonicalizing unread fixture reply bits reduces protection against a future candidate spuriously taking a path whose original has no such call; require callback-sequence negative controls, not return-only checks.
The old null-character invalid-domain prefilter remains unchanged, including its conservative exclusions. This proposal does not turn crash pairs into acceptance.
Existing fixture only tests mapped destination NULL or inventories[1], not mapped inventories[0] alias; do not describe proposal as exhaustive all possible alias graphs.
The source-level proof must be checked against original ASM if either target or callback fixture changes. Recompute counts/receipts and regenerate type/fingerprint inputs after edits.
required_future_validation: Implement the selector only in next batch and keep current capture fields and incomplete/nonzero-child rejection.
Run both selected matrices original vs replacement; require 1364 normal completed pairs each, zero differences; retain all six location values and all seven reached mutation points.
Negative control: stale cached player after equip must be rejected by mutation 1/2 cases with initial player NULL and successful equip.
Negative control: reload inventory after has/pickup callback must be rejected by unmapped initial inventory[0] cases with mutation 3/4.
Negative control: cache character or level across position callback must be rejected by drop mutation 5 and resource bit 256 cases.

Negative controls: off-by-one location boundary; wrong occupied-slot/equip-fail fallback; skipped erase; omitted/extra drop; suppressed has/pickup; mode 1 omitted/early layout. Each must fail on selected cases.
Measure focused elapsed and full-gate wall time with the same pool settings; no speedup claim from pair-count reduction alone.
